d: What is fracking and how does it work? In this video, we explain hydraulic fracturing (fracking) in simple words — from how vertical and horizontal wells are drilled thousands of feet underground, to how high-pressure fluid creates fractures in rock to release trapped oil and natural gas. Learn what fracking fluid is made of, how flowback water is managed, why fracking has been linked to groundwater contamination and earthquakes, and how it's also used in geothermal energy and environmental cleanup.
